asked.item: Working demo key to try the API before paying

verdict.reason: The pages say YOUR_API_KEY is a placeholder, API access is not in the free trial, and generating a key starts the paid plan.

steps.text: YOUR_API_KEY is a placeholder, so replace it with your own key and keep that key in your personal configuration.
The Blotato free trial includes everything except API access.
If you generate an API key in Settings > API, your free trial ends at that moment and your paid subscription begins.
Until you are ready to subscribe, use the Blotato web app instead.
